resolvedFindings.issue: CI freshness fails open for missing/nonfinite verifiedAtMs because NaN>300000 is false; future timestamps also pass. A temporally unbound CI object can therefore pass prepare/release.
resolvedFindings.requiredFix: Require finite numeric verifiedAtMs and an explicit recent bounded time interval; bind provenance to the connected GitHub check.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Gate requires verifiedBy=connected GitHub GET, finite numeric verifiedAtMs, age<=300000ms and future offset<=5000ms. Missing/nonfinite/stale/excess-future timestamp cases independently checked.
